observations: C3 DATA AVAILABILITY GATE FAILS: ALL 7 tasks have exactly 20 elements in locatable_sample. The raw data (EXP-INTEL-34782350557) was collected with locatable_sample truncated to first-20 DOM elements. Full DOM locatable_sample (n=21-82 per task) is NOT available in the existing raw evidence.

The locatable_elements counts in the metadata (82 for listing, 32 for detail, 21 for cart) represent the TOTAL number of locatable elements on the page, but the locatable_sample array was capped at 20 elements at collection time. These are distinct fields — locatable_sample is a per-element array with tag/role/ariaLabel/inForm/xywh, while locatable_elements is a scalar count.

On truncated-first-20 data (which is what IS available), baseline controls reproduce: PC1 all features eta2=1.0, NC1 hierarchy eta2=0.0, non-recipe pipeline max eta2=0.999645, ranking preserved for all 6 feature x definition combinations. This confirms the truncated-first-20 data is consistent with parent EXP-INTEL-35445596324 results.

The frozen experiment CANNOT proceed because the primary hypothesis concerns full DOM elements (n=21-82) and the data source only provides truncated-first-20 elements. No analysis of recipe sampling stability on full DOM is possible with existing data.
